node.title: Budget-three common direction zeros always agree with the received word
node.statement: For every four-codeword budget-three predecessor witness and every selected-support pattern supplied by the intersection reduction, n_0=0 makes the selected agreement sets cover D. At a common zero of the direction code all four codeword values coincide, and coverage makes at least one of them equal to the received value. Hence every common zero is a common agreement and the rank-flat mismatch parameter is exactly b=0 in all six incidence types and thirteen edge-degree chambers.
